question: Does the release-validation owner approve replacing independently prepared child candidates with the parent-produced immutable candidate after reviewing fresh, rerun, and artifact-mismatch behavior on this exact head?
rationale: The change affects the trusted release-validation and artifact-provenance boundary, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human decision rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Approve after end-to-end review

options.title: Keep independent construction
